{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Unique segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Conversion rate overall:", df['converted'].mean() * 100, '%')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column: it's string, contains thousands separators
print("Sample of revenue:", df['revenue'].head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))"}
